generator: ARIN7101 M1 reproducible synthetic template generator

episode_fields.seed: Non-negative integer RNG seed for this independent dialogue.
episode_fields.history: Ordered public messages; message IDs start at zero and are continuous.
episode_fields.probes: Ordered query records; each end is an exclusive history prefix boundary.

message_fields.id: Zero-based message index within the episode.
message_fields.text: English synthetic focus, fact, or distractor message.

probe_fields.question: Question visible to a strategy.
probe_fields.end: Exclusive upper bound; public history is history[:end].
probe_fields.gold: Current value reconstructed from all facts before this query.
probe_fields.evidence: Message ID of the last supporting statement before this query.
probe_fields.old_values: Distinct earlier values for the queried project-attribute pair.
probe_fields.qtype: recent when the question refers to the current focus; historical otherwise.
probe_fields.state: A/B demand state; only abrupt changes from A to B at T//2.

message_templates.focus: Focus is project Pn. We are reviewing its latest requirements.
message_templates.fact: For project Pn: the <attribute or alias> is Vn. <shared system context>
message_templates.distractor: The next meeting will review progress and remaining questions.

generation_rules.scenario_switch_index: T//2; abrupt switches before query t=T//2.
generation_rules.initial_conflicts: A configured fraction of project-attribute pairs begin with two distinct values.
generation_rules.updates_and_repetitions: Each round writes a new value with update_probability; otherwise repeats the current value.
generation_rules.latest_evidence: The latest statement is evidence even when it repeats the current value.

statistical_unit: independent dialogue; queries within a dialogue are dependent
